generation.mode: built-in ImageGen edit with edit-target as Image 1 and canon as reference-only Image 2

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; water-mask pixels and adjacent pixels excluded, and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or explicit sun is visible, but basalt caps are repeatedly paler than vertical faces. The literal same-value-on-every-side constraint is not met.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: Manual screen-space estimate over non-water land at native source resolution.
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent quarry-floor and plateau benches count as buildable; exposed column faces count as steep; talus, shingle, broken rims, scrub, and detached stacks make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Visual estimate rather than elevation-derived slope or world-space surface area.

crown.method: Complete native-resolution visual census found no conifer crowns; low scrub and heather were not classified as trees.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.derivation: The edge-connected teal and deep-blue source surface was traced through adjacent cool surf, wash, ripple, reflection, stream, and fall pixels; tiny enclosed cool classifier gaps were filled. The result was reviewed as a source overlay so dry cliff, talus, and stack silhouettes remain transparent.
waterMask.interiorTransparentTerrainNote: Transparent islands enclosed by sea are visibly dry stacks, columns, talus, or shore rocks, not omitted water texture.

northEdgeAudit.method: Direct census of opaque water-mask pixels on the delivered source canvas north edge.
northEdgeAudit.note: The previously missing middle ground stretch is now land, but water appears at the west end and terrain continues to about 84.8% of the edge before the eastern surf transition; the required contiguous ground-then-open-sea split is not reproduced.

refusalReasons: The previously missing middle north-edge ground is now present, but the delivered edge still fails the exact map: it adds west-end water and carries terrain to about 84.8% before the eastern surf, rather than ending ground at 69%; total north-edge water is 259/1254 pixels (20.6539%), not 31%.
Repeated pale column caps over darker vertical faces violate the literal neutral-lighting requirement despite the absence of a cast-shadow field or explicit sun.
Several long cliff sections remain too regular, with repeated upright columns and clean cap bands rather than consistently broken, split, leaning, uneven ordinary coast.
openRisks: The source cannot be corrected without violating the one-edit-call limit; its square 1254 px result does not authorize a framing retry.
Buildable and steep fractions are manual image estimates rather than surveyed geometry.
The water mask is color-and-connectivity traced and visually reviewed, but exact coastline judgment remains a human visual gate.
Seam continuity, landform naturalism, and visual quality remain director and owner judgments; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
